user_request: 依照写实风格继续优化刀的建模，最好有一些龙或冰的元素
art_direction: A practical Chinese straight double-edged steel sword, with restrained readable dragon relief on the guard and near the blade root, an opaque pale ice-jade pommel, aged silver fittings, minor dark bronze accents, and dark leather grip.
negative_direction: No cartoon ball-shaped dragon heads, large spikes, floating wires, neon emissive surfaces, transparent ice blade, excessive gilding, oversized guard, sharp protrusions into the grip, or theatrical fantasy proportions.
target_engine: Local Unreal Engine 5.8 project, PC VR via SteamVR/PICO
source_derivation: Existing selected A sword, previously refined locally to V02. Source provenance remains the existing WeaponReview/Over9000 asset chain; no new third-party asset acquisition or license change.
production_method: Local Blender geometry authoring plus deterministic procedural PBR textures; no paid provider.

constraints.normal_convention: DirectX in UE; invert green for Blender preview

acceptance: Independent FBX readback checks mesh, UVs, dimensions, grip and material slots
Successful UE import, package reload and final material bindings
No final near-zero tangent/binormal or material compilation warnings
Actual equipped VR pawn checked with seven supplied grip orientations
Visual review of final source previews and UE screenshots
scope_limits: No physical-headset acceptance or performance benchmark is implied by synthetic grip checks. Blender previews use studio lights and are distinguished from actual UE scene screenshots.
